title: The Burning Man
text: A man walks toward you along the road, on fire from head to foot, quite calm. The flames do not seem to eat him; they only keep him company. He stops a polite distance away, smoke curling from his collar, and asks if anyone has water.

options.label: The one the tides favor helps him.

outcomes.text: The flames go out. He thanks them, and promises he will remember the favor.
The flames do not go out; they spread.
He keeps walking, and the grass behind him burns for an hour.
